content: REVIEW_RESULT taskvault-mvp: design APPROVED with two constraints. 1) Storage override MUST be via TASKVAULT_STORE env var plus --store CLI flag. 2) Store MUST handle corrupt JSON with a clear error (no silent reset). Proceed with full implementation of all 8 ACs, run pytest, then report WAITING_FOR_ENGINEER for final review before any canonical completion.

payload.summary: Design approved: src/taskvault/{models,store,cli}.py, argparse entry point taskvault, versioned JSON at ~/.taskvault/tasks.json. Constraints: TASKVAULT_STORE env + --store flag override required; corrupt JSON must error clearly. Implement all 8 ACs now, pytest green, then WAITING_FOR_ENGINEER for final review. Do NOT run forgeloop complete yet.

items.description: Support TASKVAULT_STORE env var and --store CLI flag for storage path override (needed for isolated tests).
Corrupt JSON storage file must produce a clear stderr error and non-zero exit, never silent reset.
